text: I typically don’t get around to leaving reviews, but this is an exception. These replacement knobs are superior to the original. The interior part is indeed metal (vs. plastic on the original) which is a huge improvement. In addition, the lettering is better and the finish is much better. So glad I found these and they matched my Samsung stove.

I bought these because my original Samsung oven knobs cracked. The part that slides onto the oven is made of plastic on the originals and cracked at about 1 year.

However I was able to remove the thicken metal reinforcement from inside of these and screw them onto my old oven knobs. They screw holes match up perfectly. I added a two part epoxy to reinforce the plastic and they feel like they’ll last 1 millions years.

These knobs have metal stems, which seem sturdier than the original plastic stems that cracked and fell off. They are a bright finish, which I liked, but some might prefer a brushed finish like the originals had. For a 10 year old stove that has gotten a lot of use, I am not too picky about a perfect match. It looks a lot better than it did with the old broken knobs. This item arrived earlier than expected. Shipping was very prompt.

Product arrived quickly and appears to be good quality. Nice packaging. The knobs are metal and have a nice heavy feel, similar to the original knobs that came with our stove.

However, as others have mentioned, the finish is definitely shiny and doesn't really match the brushed metal of the stove. You may not care if you're replacing all 5 knobs at once, but not a great option if you only need to replace one or two.

These knobs are way better than the original knobs that came on our stove!  We were pleasantly surprised that the backs were metal instead of the flimsy plastic that the originals were made out of.

I only needed one knob replaced on my gas stove. I went ahead and bought a pack of 5 because who knows if I'll need to replace another one. I don't regret buying the pack of 5. The knob fit perfectly on my Samsung gas stove.
They fit and are useable.  When I open the hot oven door, the knobs start to make a clicking noise from the heat.

The hardest part was that the stove manual covered multiple models, and the model number was inaccessible, so I narrowed it down to to possible part numbers and got lucky on my first order.

Takes about 30 seconds to replace the knobs. They feel more solid than the original knobs. I'm glad it came in a pack of 5, because they are slightly different than the original ones. A bit more chamfer on the edges, and slightly bigger height. Don't bother pulling out a caliper to measure your knobs, just check the pictures for the hole where it slides onto the stove control rod, because they are just enough different in dimension to make you worried.

First off, what's shown is matte finish, these are shiny.  Secondly, these are not made of stainless steel, these are simply pot metal with some shiny layer of film over them to give the appearance of stainless steel.  Functionally, they are better than what Samsung sells because what Samsung sells was deliberately engineered to fail within a year or two by making the mechanical contact point out of cheap plastic.  All that said, I've learned my lesson and while Samsung makes great TV's, SSD's, memory chips and other electronics, their appliances are trash and I will never buy them again.

I purchased this set of stove gas knobs to replace the original knobs that came on our stove. These knobs are an improvement over the original knobs in that there is a steel sleeve that surrounds the plastic part of the knob that fits onto the gas valve stem. This feature makes these knobs stronger and less likely to break, which was the issue with the original. Also the fit and finish of these knobs is excellent.
